reuse.why: One guard helper is shared by all six provider link functions, but the unlink reset copies unlinkAccount's field list and the Fintegra link/download are copies of the Akahu ones rather than a shared link routine.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim copy of linkAkahuAccount, downloadFintegraTransactions of downloadAkahuTransactions, and the replace path repeats unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount block.

placement.why: Checks sit at the start of each link function in accounts/app.ts as expected, but the 'assert not linked' helper also enforces the closed-account rule and performs the unlink mutation, which do not belong in a precondition check.

scope.why: Edits serve the four requests; the desktop-client additions are required by the provider-keyed records, and three release notes are added.

maintainability.why: Per-provider copies keep growing and the shared helper has become a mixed-purpose function (closed check, duplicate check, redundant target lookup, side-effecting unlink) whose name no longer describes it.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked re-implements the local part of unlinkAccount instead of sharing it; linkFintegraAccount/downloadFintegraTransactions copy the Akahu bodies.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies (Fintegra link and download, unlink reset) are literal, only the provider names change.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked gained replaceExistingLink plus a closed-account branch on upgradingId and a replace branch (with its own target-existence lookup and unlink writes); all six link functions call it.
